name: Spinal Accessory Nerve Palsy
definition: Injury to cranial nerve XI causing trapezius weakness, shoulder droop and lateral scapular winging, often after neck surgery or trauma.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and ultrasound/MRI are selected according to suspected lesion.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Early shoulder ROM and scapular rehabilitation
amber: Early repair may be considered after transection; chronic cases may need tendon transfer.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa/Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Injury to cranial nerve XI causing trapezius weakness, shoulder droop and lateral scapular winging, often after neck surgery or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
